item.title: Matsushima Bay: One of Japan's Three Great Views — Guide
item.description: Matsushima is one of Japan’s three canonically great views — a calm bay scattered with over 260 pine-covered islands, each shaped by centuries of wave erosion into arches, caves and pinnacles draped in wind-twisted black pines. Viewed from the Saigyo Modoshi no Matsu hilltop at dusk, the islands recede in layers of blue-grey haze that seem more painting than reality. Boat cruises wind between the islands at water level, revealing hidden grottoes and cormorant colonies.
